```{ojs}
//| label: sweep-ui

viewof sweep_mechanism = Inputs.select([
  "Label Bias",
  "Task Difficulty", 
  "Feature Predictivity",
  "Proxies",
  "Base Rate Difference"
], {label: "Mechanism to Sweep", value: "Label Bias"})

sweep_mechanism_val = Generators.input(viewof sweep_mechanism)

viewof sweep_dataset_size = Inputs.range([1000, 10000], {value: 5000, step: 1000, label: "Sweep Dataset Size"})
sweep_dataset_size_val = Generators.input(viewof sweep_dataset_size)

viewof run_sweep_btn = Inputs.button("Run Sweep")
run_sweep_trigger = Generators.input(viewof run_sweep_btn)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: sweep-logic
sweep_results = {
  run_sweep_trigger;
  
  let results = [];
  
  // Clean configuration
  const baselineConfig = {
    feature_predictivity: 0,
    proxies: 0,
    task_diff: 0,
    label_bias: 0,
    base_rate_diff: "0.50 / 0.50"
  };

  const steps = sweep_mechanism_val === "Base Rate Difference" 
    ? ["0.25 / 0.50", "0.25 / 0.75", "0.50 / 0.25", "0.50 / 0.50", "0.50 / 0.75", "0.75 / 0.25", "0.75 / 0.50"]
    : d3.range(0, 1.1, 0.1);

  for (let val of steps) {
    let overrideConfig = { ...baselineConfig };
    
    // Apply sweep value
    if (sweep_mechanism_val === "Label Bias") overrideConfig.label_bias = val;
    if (sweep_mechanism_val === "Task Difficulty") overrideConfig.task_diff = val;
    if (sweep_mechanism_val === "Feature Predictivity") overrideConfig.feature_predictivity = val;
    if (sweep_mechanism_val === "Proxies") overrideConfig.proxies = val;
    if (sweep_mechanism_val === "Base Rate Difference") overrideConfig.base_rate_diff = val;

    // Build Train Data
    const trainData = buildDataset(sweep_dataset_size_val, 42, true, overrideConfig);
    
    // Train Model
    const weights = trainLR(trainData, 500, 0.5);
    
    // Build Test Data
    const testData = buildDataset(1000, 200, false, overrideConfig);
    
    // Evaluate
    const metrics = evaluateModel(testData, weights);
    
    let x_val = val;

    results.push({ x: x_val, metric: "TPR Gap", value: metrics.tpr_gap });
    results.push({ x: x_val, metric: "Balanced Accuracy Gap", value: metrics.bal_acc_gap });
    results.push({ x: x_val, metric: "AUC Gap", value: metrics.auc_gap });
    results.push({ x: x_val, metric: "Statistical Parity Diff", value: metrics.sp_diff });
  }
  
  return results;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: sweep-plots-render
html`<div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; background: #0f172a; border-radius: 8px;">
  ${Plot.plot({
    title: "Fairness Metrics vs " + sweep_mechanism_val,
    x: { label: sweep_mechanism_val, type: sweep_mechanism_val === "Base Rate Difference" ? "point" : "linear", grid: true },
    y: { label: "Absolute Gap", domain: [0, 1], tickFormat: "%", grid: true },
    color: { legend: true, domain: ["TPR Gap", "Balanced Accuracy Gap", "AUC Gap", "Statistical Parity Diff"], range: ["#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#ef4444"] },
    marks: [ 
      Plot.line(sweep_results, {x: "x", y: "value", stroke: "metric", strokeWidth: 3}), 
      Plot.dot(sweep_results, {x: "x", y: "value", fill: "metric", r: 5}) 
    ],
    width: 800, height: 450, style: { background: "#1e293b", color: "#e2e8f0", fontSize: "16px" }
  })}
</div>`
```
